scope: Two locally altered AC1012 scratch witnesses; single-page physical object-map census and GEODATA class binding.
method: Independently decode bounded section locators, one object-map page, unsigned handle deltas and signed location deltas; validate page and terminator CRCs, each frame size/CRC, self handle and type, and nonoverlap. Compare the full mapped handle/type set to LibreDWG JSON. Reuse the version-aware physical CLASS section walker to bind all class rows and the selected GEODATA row against the peer decode.
result: Both samples have 44 mapped CRC-checked frames and zero mapped frame types equal to the physical GEODATA class number 531; the full handle/type sets match LibreDWG. The CLASS field count itself remains absent in R13.
tests: Synthetic maps reject broken map, frame and terminator CRC, duplicate handles and locations, changed self handle with repaired CRC, and truncation; corrected retries match. A valid physical type change is counted.
Physical CLASS name corruption with a repaired class CRC is rejected, and an unchanged retry succeeds.
The existing legacy dictionary wire controls pass.
limits: The census covers these single-page, short-frame synthetic samples and addressable map entries only.
The new observer does not prove native AutoCAD validity or semantic support and does not establish how the output writer handles an unused proxy CLASS.
The unsafe diagnostic layout bypass is not part of the PR. The existing GEODATA and layout gates remain.
No DWG or DXF fixture is committed.
